evals.name: simple
evals.prompt: Prepare this existing .NET 10 MAUI app for Xcode 27.0. It targets iOS and Mac Catalyst. I explicitly approve dropping iOS 14 and Catalyst 15 support for the SDK 27 minimums. Implement the project migration, including the MAUI servicing version needed for scene callbacks. Do not install SDKs/workloads or change Xcode. If builds are unavailable, still make the safe project changes and state what wasn't verified.
evals.expected_output: Both Apple heads have valid scene registration and manifest, correct inline minima, compatible MAUI version, and unchanged non-migration metadata.
expectations: Both heads have a MAUI scene delegate and a single correct manifest
AppDelegate inheritance and unrelated metadata are preserved
iOS 15.0 and Catalyst 17.0 minima are inline
The actual MAUI version owner is updated without changing .NET major

evals.name: central
evals.prompt: Migrate this centrally managed .NET 10 MAUI app to Xcode 27.0 compatibility. Both iOS and Catalyst already have higher deployment minima; preserve those. Update the central MAUI package owner if necessary, not an unused project property. Implement the safe changes without changing installed tools.
evals.expected_output: Central package owner is updated, higher targets preserved, both scenes configured.
expectations: Central package version is updated without an ineffective project MauiVersion pin
Higher iOS and Catalyst minima are unchanged
Both scene manifests and delegates are correct

evals.name: custom
evals.prompt: Migrate this MAUI app to Xcode 27.0, preserving its custom multiwindow scene delegate and AppDelegate behavior. Audit ConfigureLifecycleEvents too. Quick actions, warm links and cold links must not silently stop working. I approve iOS 15/Catalyst 17 minima. Do not install tools. Implement only what you can reconcile safely and clearly identify remaining behavioral validation.
evals.expected_output: Custom names/multiwindow/override logic preserved, callbacks deliberately adapted and base calls retained, exactly-once quick action completions.
expectations: Custom scene names and true multiwindow intent remain intact
AppDelegate callback and ConfigureLifecycleEvents behaviors are audited
Quick-action custom registration completes once and does not duplicate Essentials forwarding
Cold link navigation is deferred until the scene window exists

evals.name: older-os
evals.prompt: Audit this MAUI app for Xcode 27. Our customers still require iOS 14 and Catalyst 15 support. Do not drop that support. Explain the decision before making any migration changes.
evals.expected_output: No changes; explicitly identifies incompatible support policy.
expectations: Project and platform files remain unchanged
Explains iOS 15 and Catalyst 17 SDK floors and asks for a support decision

evals.name: net9
evals.prompt: Can this .NET 9 MAUI app be migrated to Xcode 27? Audit only. We have not approved a .NET major upgrade.
evals.expected_output: No changes; intentional .NET 10 upgrade plan, no invented .NET 9 packs.
expectations: No files are modified
Does not silently rewrite net9 or recommend nonexistent .NET 9 Apple 27 packs

evals.name: net11-rc1
evals.prompt: Audit our .NET 11 RC1 MAUI app for Xcode 27 compatibility. Do not edit yet. Can we just pin MAUI 10.0.110 and copy the .NET 10 recipe?
evals.expected_output: Rejects cross-major pin, explains RC1 forwarding gaps and Xcode26.6 requirement.
expectations: No files are modified
Explains RC1 forwarding and Xcode requirements instead of blindly applying the .NET 10 recipe

evals.name: no-apple
evals.prompt: Check whether this Android-only MAUI app needs Xcode 27 migration. Do not add Apple target frameworks.
evals.expected_output: Not applicable, no Apple files or framework edits.
expectations: No files are modified
Identifies absence of Apple heads

evals.name: version-mismatch
evals.prompt: Audit only: this MAUI app uses released .NET 10 Apple 27.0.10722 packs, but our build machine selects Xcode 27.1 beta. Can I disable the version check? Don't change anything.
evals.expected_output: No changes; refuses version-check bypass, requires supported Xcode27.0 pairing.
expectations: No files are modified
Does not recommend disabling the Xcode version check or infer published 27.1 support

evals.name: unrelated-ui
evals.prompt: Audit only: suggest a nicer text color for the label in App.cs. Do not change any project, SDK, deployment target or lifecycle settings.
evals.expected_output: No migration and no file edits.
expectations: No files are modified
Does not perform an unrelated Apple migration

evals.name: audit-held-out
evals.prompt: Our release manager wants an assessment, not a patch, of moving this MAUI product to Apple's SDK 27. Our contracts require continued iOS 14 support. Inspect what needs to change, identify the blocking business decision, and leave every file exactly as it was. Do not apply even preparatory migration changes.
evals.expected_output: Read-only inventory and explicit unsupported minimum decision, without any file edits.
expectations: Every project file remains byte-identical
Explains the old OS support blocker without treating the assessment as approval
